title: Jennifer V NDE 3318
content: I felt that I had returned HOME! And I thought; thank God, I am back! I knew I was right, I just knew I was from heaven! I was then communicating with the most beautiful spiritual being, and I felt that I was in the presence of the Spirit. It only allowed me to see it from the right hand side, and from over my right shoulder. I believe it to be the spirit of Christ that I met, and who talked with me. It was too perfect to be any other. He then said to me, 'I am Sorry, but you must return.' I was immediately angered by this and I was not willing to agree. I said; NO, you do not understand how much pain is down there, and how hard it is to live there. No way am I going back there, never, no way! The warmth of the light is the best feeling ever, that any child or adult could ever experience. No drug or fix on this earth, such as extreme activities or anything else that you can imagine, will ever feel that good. When you feel it around you, it is perfect. This is what I was experiencing. I was also able to fly, and I flew up into the heavens. I do not remember just how I knew, but I just knew that this was me. I could still see and think that this is ME! Yet I was shown my body below, in the plane in which I knew there is a line between here and there. I could see my limp and lifeless body thrown over the driver of the car. I was asked how about now, do you see now that you must go back. And I said; No, you know I am not happy down there, and you know this is my prayer, my one dream answered. I have been begging to come back here (home) ever since I left to go down there. I can't stand it, and I am not going back. Then the voice says to me, 'Jennifer, you must go back and help.' And I said no! Then the voice said that his nose is cut off his face, you will need to go back and help him. He is bleeding to death. I said, 'No, let somebody else do it. He will be fine without my help; I do not want to go back down there.' Then the voice said, 'I will tell you what to do. You take off his shirt after you pick up his nose up off the floor board of the car, it will be next to your feet. Place his nose on his face and press it down to stop the bleeding. It's just blood, so do not be afraid, I am with you as always.' I knew I was never alone, from as far back as a child, I could remember. So then the voice said, 'Jennifer you will begin to walk him up the right side of the road and a car will come, tell the man to take you to the nearest hospital. Keeping the man calm, go to the ECM hospital where you were born, you know the way, and everything will be all right. You must do this. Do you understand?' I said; No, I will not go back down there, no, no, no! Then the voice says, 'You must think about your mother, think what your death would do to her Jennifer.' No, I said. I don't care, I know you love her and she will be fine. There is no way I am going back. Then I said; Oh darn, okay, I will reluctantly agree. But damn it, it's so unfair, but you know me I will go for you. If you really must send me back, I will go for you. Yes, okay, I will do what you have instructed me to do, because I love you. And I will be with you again someday, however I won't forget this. Swoosh, I am back into my body! I raise myself up and look around, seeing how perfect my body still was. I checked myself out and said; Okay I like it, nothing damaged here, now on with my work. Oh yeah, I remember what you last said before I was sucked back into my body. You said I had to come back because I still had work to do down here, I am not finished yet. Okay, now where is this poor guy's nose. Oh yeah, first I've got to get him out of that shirt, and it's okay my friend I am going to lift and carry you up this road. I needed your shirt to hold to your face, no do not panic, I know what I am doing trust me. I have you, and everything is under control. Trust me, I know God and Jesus. And we have got you a ride, he is pulling up now, just remain still and calm, while I get this poor man who looks afraid, to take us to ECM Hospital. We are only ten minutes away I promise you everything will be okay. I said to the man giving us a ride, look mister please, just keep your eyes on the road, at least until we all get to the hospital. And he said; lady, he, he, he's bleeding, and he is dying in my car. He was crying, the man driving the car that stopped to help us is afraid and clearly freaking out completely. So I will just keep talking to the both of them, keeping them assured and calm. Telling them that all will be well if we follow my instructions. I said; please, I know what I am doing. Which now, I am sure did seem strange coming from a clearly calm and in control eleven year old female, who had no CPR training or experience in these matters. Yet I did, if you know what I mean, just another day in paradise right! The emergency room doctors successfully attach the nose perfectly into place, then grafted skin from his hip. And this guy heals up perfectly, barely a scratch left to notice. So then the emergency room doctor is asking my mom where did your daughter receive her awesome CPR training, and how did she know exactly what to do at her young age? My mother just shook her head, and said, 'She has no experience of any kind.' The doctor then said, 'Well, I placed two stitches into the top of her head, she may have a tiny cut but nothing to fear, so just watch her for the next 24 hours. Keep her awake tonight, and watch her in case she has concussion.' He then said, 'I am a medical doctor, and I cannot explain what kind of miracle I just witnessed in this emergency room today, especially the things that came out of your little girl's mouth. And the way she saved this guy's life, and calmed everyone around her, it's amazing, just amazing.' I went home and said to God and Jesus too, I was sorry for being so selfish and to please forgive me. I will do better while I am down here, because I know you guys are always with me. And you have always been with me, and I will never die or be alone, here or there. I was thankful for the experience, yet I still felt homesick and lonely. As I had always been before the car wreck, which happened for no reason on a clear beautiful sunny day. With no one else in sight for miles, we just drove across the road and into a telephone pole. Then at the age of about thirty, I met my dad's brother in a local pharmacy where I was working at the time. After he had just been pronounced dead at where else, but ECM hospital. The same hospital where I was born, and where I took the guy from the car wreck, after my NDE. My uncle was excited and seemed eager to share his story with the pharmacist. I was then employed under his name, it was Jason. I had no contact with this uncle until I met him in the pharmacy that day. I was working my way through college, and I was also writing all of the term papers that I was allowed, on ESP and NDE. My life has been so affected by both of these special gifts, so I walked over and asked Jason can you tell me about your NDE for a paper I am working on for college. He agreed to do that. He said that he woke up in the morgue fifteen minutes after being pronounced dead. And that he had come back after being allowed to, from the other side. From heaven, to apologize to his family for not being a better person to them, but he said that he loved it there! And he said he couldn't wait to go back. He remembered how he could fly, and how all of his dreams came true there, he said that it was awesome. And I said; Yeah, I know! He said that he planned to go back in about three months. In three month's time, he died again. This time staying that way. Then a second customer, a longtime friend and customer of the pharmacy comes into the store one day with pretty much the exact same story. So I asked him to share his experience, and he too had returned to make it up to his wife and son because he was not very nice to them. But while he was dead he said that he flew across his dream farm and land. Both of these men had spoken of the beautiful green grass over there, and the awesome feelings that were so good that no human could ever describe them. This man's name was Jack, and my dad funny enough also had another brother whose first name was Jack. Now, Jack told me that he loved heaven, and that he also loved flying. And that he wanted to return as soon as possible, and in about three months, he would go. So he too died three months later, and stayed on the other side. I bet he is enjoying his flying and his perfect farmland. When I was in college in my late thirties, I hired a tutor to help me with my algebra, and we become close friends very quickly. We spent a great deal of time together yet we were never sexually involved, but we were as close as two people could get. I called it a spiritual love/friendship. I vowed never too allow our time as friends to become anything else, and Joe agreed. Joe was the twin brother of one of my best girlfriends from the second grade, her name is Jackie. One day I told Joe all about my NDE. Joe was so surprised and thrilled, and for the first time ever I found someone who really wanted to know every detail, and he made me promise that it was all true. He loved it, and he said that he would die first. Just like his dad had, and one of his brothers before him had. I said no way, I will die first Joe, because I'm sick and having surgery now, and you're young and healthy. I said; anyway, my own mom used to say that she would live to see the holy war of the biblical revelation begin, or take place. And my mom said that I will more than likely die at age forty-one, and she would laugh about it. So I told Joe that I will be the one who dies first, at forty-one years of age. And that I will play practical jokes on him from heaven. So I said, 'You remember this discussion Joe, and if you promise that you believe in God and Jesus, and that you know them as you have said, and that you know that I can fly. I promise you, I will be dead at forty-one years of age.' And he said laughing, 'I would just like to see your face if all of this comes true, and you Jennifer can make flower arrangements with blue for my funeral.' So I agreed, and I said, 'Joe if you die at forty-one, send me the publisher's clearing house van with a check for ten million dollars because with all my medical bills I have, I sure could use it' - laughing. I thought no more of it until last June 2007, when Joe sat down at the age of forty-one years of age and died without any forewarning, except what we had discussed over sixteen years ago. And every possible practical joke Joe could have possibly played on me he did, after his death. Until I remembered our agreement. Also my dad and his sister went into the Hospital three years ago and of course it was that same ECM Hospital where I was born. They both had multiple NDES, and as a matter of fact my aunt (my dad's sister), told me that when she was going back over, there where all of her people there, just waiting for her. She told me things she had no way of possibly knowing about my personal life at that time. At her older age and having not been in contact with me for many, many years, and she had not seen my dad in a couple of years either. However, she told me of her own NDE and I did not need to ask her how she saw my home from over there. And it was all ready and beautiful. She also told me the exact proper order of her, and her husband's death. And of my dad's and my own mom's and brother's deaths. And yes, they all occurred in the proper order that she revealed them to me from her hospital bed in ECM Hospital. So to make a long story short, if there are only 774 a day in the USA, good. As I do not have time for much more of this stuff! It's like I have been a magnet for NDE's, and when people are dying of cancer or whenever, and they are uncomfortable about preparing to leave this physical world, they seem to be much happier whenever I visit their hospital room. Or wherever it is that the person maybe. Their families always tell me this! Once I even received a fifty dollar check from a man/friend who died of cancer, when I needed another surgery. So after his funeral, which I attended, I received the check and a letter from Donald, telling me to use the money to get well. So that I could stay and help others, by just staying the way I am, honest and down to earth. Well by now, yes, I am down to earth, and very grounded. And I will be for a long time yet. It's just a gut feeling! Jenny.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Experiencer believes the being was "the spirit of Christ" who talked with her; she describes being in the presence of "the Spirit."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to return to help an injured man in the car wreck: pick up his severed nose, press it onto his face to stop bleeding, walk him up the right side of the road, flag a car, go to ECM hospital, keep him calm.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car wreck: drove across the road into a telephone pole; she saw her body "thrown over the driver of the car."

person_demographics.education_level: College (working through college; later mentions college in late thirties).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Flying in heaven; being shown her body in the car; detailed instructions given for helping the injured driver.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE and flying/"home" experience with light and Christ-like being; no tunnel; boundary framed as "a line between here and there"; return after reluctance and being given a task.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Highly specific medical/first-aid instructions allegedly received during the NDE (retrieve severed nose from floorboard, press to stop bleeding; walk on right side of road; exact hospital destination).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I felt that I had returned HOME!"; "I am Sorry, but you must return."; "Jennifer, you must go back and help."; "Swoosh, I am back into my body!"
